mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.media_id, s.app_id, s.name, s.name_alise, s.ad_scene, s.ad_size, s.ssp_pay_type, s.ssp_deal_ratio, s.fixed_price, s.ad_image, s.enable, s.creator, s.create_time, s.updater, s.update_time, s.deleted, s.tenant_id, m.media_company_short as mediaShortName, a.access_type as accessType, a.name as appName, a.os_type as osType FROM ssp_slot_info as s LEFT JOIN ssp_media as m ON m.id = s.media_id LEFT JOIN ssp_app as a ON a.id = s.app_id WHERE s.id = #{id}
